comment.body: This is a request for an optional restore-on-exit/default-profile behavior rather than evidence of a broken existing contract. Please separate the desired scope (brightness only versus contrast/color temperature) and whether default means values captured when Power Display starts or factory defaults; changing monitor values automatically on exit should be opt-in.
